title: Editorial guidelines
slide_intent: Teach writers to make routine choices about voice, capitalization and tense consistently so the reader can concentrate on the subject.
strategic_value: Voltera can keep writing recognizable across contributors by giving each editor the same small set of decisions and examples.
demonstration: The introduction specifies Canadian Press style and American spelling. Four groups below address point of view, capitalization, case and tense.
practical_value: Choose first-person plural for company prose and use the page’s separate case guidance for a button, a subheading or body text.
